title: 'Tekong darat' jailed 2 years for smuggling Myanmar migrant
summary: KOTA BARU: The High Court here today sentenced a 31-year-old ‘tekong darat’ (migrant smuggler) to two years’ jail for transporting an undocumented Myanmar migrant in Pasir Mas in June.
